summary_en: ¥37/share annual dividend (¥3 increase from ¥34 forecast); payout ratio 85.5%; interim ¥37, year-end ¥37; FY2026/9 (ended September 2026). Driven by upward revision of earnings forecast (net income ¥966M vs. ¥908M prior forecast), achieved through higher Wevox profitability and cost efficiencies despite Green segment headwinds and strategic investment execution.
title_en: Notification of Revision of FY2026/9 Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Atrae announced on 31 July 2026 a revision of its FY2026/9 (10 October 2025 – 30 September 2026) dividend forecast, raising the annual dividend per share from ¥34 to ¥37—a ¥3 increase. The company will distribute ¥37 at the interim (Q2) and ¥37 at the year-end, resulting in a payout ratio of 85.5%.

The dividend hike reflects an upward revision of the full-year earnings forecast. Net income is now projected at ¥966 million (up from ¥908 million previously), driven by stronger-than-expected profitability in the Wevox segment, particularly higher-margin SMBC Wevox partnerships, and disciplined cost management despite strategic investments in product development, marketing, and talent. The company notes that the current-period ROE is expected to exceed its disclosed 20% target.

The company stated that dividend continuation is a core capital policy objective, balanced against investments in new business deployment and efficiency. The timing change of the record date from end-September to end-October 31 is designed to facilitate shareholder engagement ahead of annual shareholder meetings now held in January.
